meta.name: dot-ai-write-docs
meta.description: Write documentation with real, validated examples. Executes commands through the user to capture actual output. Use for any new documentation or major doc updates.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过执行命令生成带真实示例的文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在文档中嵌入可验证的命令输出示例
copy.tagline_en: Generate documentation with real command output examples
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to embed verified command output in documentation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先执行命令获取真实输出，再逐段写文档。它负责搭建测试环境、运行基础设施命令，只让你操作 MCP 客户端并分享结果。
howto.when: 当你要求写新文档或大幅更新现有文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份知识库使用指南。
say.note: Claude 会先搭建环境并执行示例。

say.text: 更新 MCP 设置文档。
say.note: Claude 会验证现有步骤是否有效。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude executes commands to capture real output before writing documentation chunk by chunk. It handles infrastructure setup and bash commands, asking you only for MCP client interactions and sharing results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write new documentation or make major updates to existing docs.

say_en.text: Write a guide for the knowledge base feature.
say_en.note: Claude will set up environment and run examples first.
